installation.title: eSIM installation guide
installation.subtitle: Install before your trip when possible. Keep your primary SIM active if you still need calls or SMS on your usual number.
installation.iphone_step3: Scan the QR code from your eSIM order, or use the install link shown on the order page.
installation.iphone_step4: Label the line so you can recognize it while travelling.
installation.iphone_step5: Choose the eSIM as your mobile data line and enable data roaming when the plan requires it.
installation.android_step2: Choose Add eSIM and scan the QR code.
installation.android_step3: Enable the new eSIM and select it for mobile data.
installation.android_step4: Enable data roaming and configure the APN when the provider requires it.
installation.after_install_text: Turn off Wi-Fi briefly and toggle airplane mode if the network does not connect immediately. Your order page contains the APN and activation values when they are provided for your package.

compatibility.title: Is your phone eSIM compatible?
compatibility.subtitle: Your device must support eSIM and must not be carrier-locked in a way that blocks another network profile.
compatibility.iphone_text: Most recent iPhone models support eSIM. In Settings → Cellular, look for an option to add an eSIM.
compatibility.android_text: Support varies by manufacturer, model and market. Samsung and Pixel devices are common examples, but check your exact model.
compatibility.check_text: Search your model in the phone manufacturer's specification page and confirm that eSIM is supported for your country/variant. Also verify that the device is unlocked.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers for the common parts of buying, installing and managing a travel eSIM.

questions.q1: When should I install my eSIM?
questions.a1: Install it before you travel when practical. Depending on the package, validity may start on installation, first connection, or first use; check the plan details you receive.
questions.q2: Can I keep my normal SIM active?
questions.a2: Usually yes. You can keep your primary line for calls/SMS and select the eSIM for mobile data. Be careful with data roaming on the primary line to avoid unexpected charges.
questions.q3: How do I check my data usage?
questions.a3: Open My eSIMs, select the order, then use Check usage. Some operators do not expose real-time usage through the provider API.
questions.q4: Can I top up an eSIM?
questions.a4: Only compatible operators/packages can be topped up. Open the eSIM details page and choose Top up data when compatible options are available.
questions.q5: What if I lose my QR code?
questions.a5: Open My eSIMs and your completed order again. Your activation details are retained there when the provider returns them.
questions.q6: What happens if a plan needs ID verification?
questions.a6: The order stays processing and a verification link is shown when the provider returns one. Complete verification before the eSIM can finish activation.
questions.q7: Can I buy an eSIM for someone else?
questions.a7: Yes. Use the recipient's email during checkout so the delivery information goes to them, or share the QR/install details securely after purchase.
